daily.today_energy: The cosmic vibes are asking you to lean into your natural charm today, Libra. Your energy feels grounded yet expansive—perfect for authentic connections and honest conversations with people who matter.
daily.love: Someone around you is noticing your glow. Whether you're coupled up or exploring, today's energy favors vulnerability over overthinking. Let yourself feel what's real instead of balancing every emotion.
daily.career: Your collaborative energy is peaking. This is the day to share those ideas you've been sitting on. Your voice carries weight right now, and people are genuinely listening to what you have to say.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and breath work today. A walk, some stretching, or even a few minutes of intentional breathing can shift your whole vibe. Listen to what feels nourishing, not what feels obligatory.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about recalibrating your inner compass, Libra. You're being called to trust your gut more than your overthinking mind. A shift mid-week brings fresh momentum—lean into it without needing everything figured out first.
weekly.love: Your heart's actually more decisive than you think rn. Whether you're coupled up or solo, there's a vibe shift asking you to be real about what you actually want. Stop playing it safe in conversations—vulnerability hits different this week.
weekly.career: Your ideas are sharper than usual, but the real magic happens when you stop seeking validation for every move. Trust that quiet confidence thing and pitch that project or thought you've been sitting on. The energy supports bold clarity over perfectionism.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Dance, walk, stretch—whatever makes you feel alive rather than like you're checking boxes. Energy flows where attention goes, so tune into what genuinely nourishes you this week.
